narrative_summary: In the past 48 hours, multiple drone-related incidents have been reported, reflecting diverse issues ranging from smuggling and prison disruptions to emerging security policies. Most notably, several cases of illegal drone flights over South Carolina prisons highlight ongoing challenges with contraband delivery. Security concerns prompted Philippine authorities to ban unauthorized drone activities during the Asean Summit. Meanwhile, drone attacks in Leningrad caused significant disruption to air traffic at St. Petersburg's Pulkovo Airport. Additionally, discussions on counter-drone measures have gained urgency as new insights into aerial threats emerge globally, including drone-related terrorist activities. These trends underscore increasing recognition of the need for effective drone regulation and protective measures across various sectors.
